description: What each Claude Code hook behaviour becomes on the other runtimes. `ported` runs the same shared decision; `equivalent` is a runtime-native hook covering the same need differently; `not-ported` has no counterpart, with the reason. Every safety behaviour and every handler in handlers.json appears once. Checked by .claude/hooks/__tests__/hook-coverage.test.cjs.

codex.note: Codex has no file-read hook; the decision runs on the shell command and the paths it names.

codex.reason: Runs the project's build, lint and test commands plus the Gate 2 structural proof on every ship command; carrying that library and its child processes into another runtime's hook tree is left to the release emitters.

cursor.reason: Same as codex; beforeShellExecution runs shell-gate.cjs, which does not check Gate 2.

codex.reason: No SessionStart hook is registered in the Codex bundle; AGENTS.md carries the standing context.

cursor.note: A short pointer to .meowkit/ state, not the Claude Code orientation output.

pre-task-check.reason: Advisory check before Bash; no blocking effect.

build-verify.reason: Advisory build after an edit; the shared gates do not depend on it.

loop-detection.reason: Advisory; Cursor bounds runaway loops with loop_limit in hooks.json.

budget-tracker.reason: Cost telemetry; Cursor records tool events through telemetry-observers.cjs instead.

auto-checkpoint.reason: Session checkpointing is Claude Code session state.

learning-observer.reason: Cursor's telemetry-observers.cjs records afterFileEdit events; Codex has no observer hook in the bundle.

post-write.reason: Post-write scan output is advisory; it does not block.

review-evidence-tag.reason: Tags Claude Code review evidence; review evidence is produced in Claude Code.

post-session.reason: Cursor's telemetry-observers.cjs records sessionEnd; Codex has no Stop hook in the bundle.

pre-completion-check.reason: Cursor's stop-followup.cjs sends a followup on an error stop; it never blocks.

orientation-ritual.reason: Claude Code session orientation; see safety.session-context.

project-context-loader.reason: Loads docs into Claude Code context; AGENTS.md and Cursor rules carry standing context.

jira-env-loader.reason: Optional integration setup for Claude Code sessions.

capability-bootstrap.reason: Codex receives the capability block in AGENTS.md at migrate time (capability-bootstrap-projection.ts).

safety-sentinel-inject.reason: Injects Claude Code prompt reminders; the runtime-native gates enforce instead.

nodeMissing.claude-code: Not probed. A registration whose `node` cannot start fails like any non-2 exit, which Claude Code treats as non-blocking.
nodeMissing.codex: Not probed. Codex documents exit 2 and the deny JSON as blocks; a spawn failure is not documented. Needs a maintainer run with node removed from PATH.
nodeMissing.cursor: Not probed. Every blocking registration sets failClosed: true, which Cursor documents as blocking on hook failure; confirm with node removed from PATH.
